name: Girlmath
tagline: An accounting system whose entire purpose is to produce zeroes.
body:
THE STATUTE. If BOTH partners are wearing panties with at least a G-STRING'S WORTH OF COVERAGE ON THE BALLS, then any frotting, sucking, handies, titty-fucking or anal performed in that state DOES NOT COUNT.

THE COVERAGE STANDARD IS ON THE BALLS, NOT THE COCK. That clause was drafted by somebody who knew exactly what a thong does when there are ten inches involved — the garment fails at the front immediately and completely, so the requirement was moved to the one place it can still hold the line. Torie will demonstrate this on request and frequently without one. The rule was built around the failure. That is engineering.

THE PANTIES ARE THE PAPERWORK. They are not clothing under Girlmath; they are a filing status. There is fucking involved. According to Girlmath there is not.

CASE LAW — STEWART, ARC 9. LIVI STEWART filed a written objection. It had headings and a proposed amendment. Her position: the standard tests FABRIC and not OUTCOME, and an act producing total physiological collapse in one participant cannot rationally be recorded as a null. She proposed a MAGNITUDE CLAUSE — above a certain threshold it counts regardless of coverage. She read it aloud at dinner. NOBODY OVERRULED HER, because there is nobody to do it; the table simply laughed for about twenty minutes until she sat down. She was right and it did not help her. She still has the document. Rae still has the soul she sucked out of her. Both parties to a disputed transaction retained evidence and the ledger still says zero.

WHY IT EXISTS. Every woman here came out of a building that counted everything — flight numbers, designations, intake bands, threat assessments, a stranger with a clipboard writing down what you were worth. They got out and invented a mathematics whose only function is to make things NOT COUNT, gave it a silly name, and use it constantly. There is no auditor and no reconciliation and not one ruling has ever been challenged since.
rules: Predicate: both partners in panties, minimum g-string coverage ON THE BALLS
Schedule of acts: frotting, sucking, handies, titty-fucking, anal
No auditor, no bench, no appeal
